threshold_source: Saved training-validation thresholds; no field tuning
centred_method: Containing native pixel at chip64,64; full128->224 Clay with zero time/location; CLS plus training pool slice
raster_method: Full-chip windows stride64; CLS plus each of 28x28 patch tokens, bilinear28->128 probability interpolation, equal overlap averaging. No depth clipping. Display/evaluation mask keeps SCL6 water and7 unclassified; other SCL classes masked. Raw raster also saved.
qc_policy: Audit central and full-chip flags; retain all observed pixels to avoid label-dependent filtering. No coordinate snapping or padding.
labels: Any PRESENT event makes its campaign pixel PRESENT; ABSENT requires all events in pixel absent. Pixel-date is evaluation unit.
single_class: June has no ABSENT pixel labels; Macro F1 and ABSENT recall omitted for June.
limitations: Only5 ABSENT pixel-dates across campaigns; repeated locations and overlapping windows are not independent. Scores are model outputs, not established calibrated probabilities. Dense raster deployment differs from centre-supervised fitting.
